abstract: The use of machine learning methods for predictive purposes has exponentially increased over the past two decades, but uncertainty quantification for predictive comparisons remains challenging and underdeveloped. This article addresses this gap by extending the classic inference theory for predictive ability in time series to modern machine learners, such as Lasso or Deep Learning. We investigate under which conditions such extensions are possible. For standard out-of-sample asymptotic inference to be valid with machine learning, two key properties must hold: (i) a zero-mean condition for the score of the prediction loss function and (ii) a “fast rate” of convergence for the machine learner. Absent any of these conditions, the estimation risk may be unbounded, and inferences invalid and very sensitive to sample splitting. For accurate inferences, we recommend an 80%–20% training-test splitting rule. We illustrate the wide applicability of our results with three applications: high-dimensional time series regressions with Lasso, Deep learning for binary outcomes, and a new out-of-sample test for the Martingale Difference Hypothesis (MDH). The theoretical results are supported by extensive Monte Carlo simulations and an empirical application evaluating the MDH of some major exchange rates.
abstract_zh: 过去二十年间，机器学习方法在预测领域的应用呈指数级增长，然而，针对预测比较的不确定性量化仍具挑战性且发展不足。本文通过将时间序列预测能力的经典推断理论扩展至现代机器学习方法，如Lasso或深度学习，来填补这一空白。我们探讨了此类扩展在何种条件下可行。要使标准的样本外渐近推断在机器学习背景下有效，需满足两个关键性质：（i）预测损失函数得分的零均值条件，及（ii）机器学习器达到“快速收敛率”。若任一条件缺失，估计风险可能无界，推断结果将失效且对样本分割极为敏感。为获得准确推断，我们建议采用80%-20%的训练-测试分割比例。我们通过三个应用实例展示了研究结果的广泛适用性：高维时间序列回归中的Lasso方法、二分类结果的深度学习，以及针对鞅差假设（MDH）的新型样本外检验。理论结果得到了广泛蒙特卡洛模拟及一项评估主要汇率MDH的实证应用的支持。
title: Extending the Scope of Inference About Predictive Ability to Machine Learning Methods
title_zh: 扩展预测能力推断范围至机器学习方法

abstract: We consider general models of linear interactions in binary outcomes. We first characterize the conditions under which these models are coherent and complete. Next, we show that models of linear interactions admit sound microfoundations under assumptions of incomplete information and independence. To help guide practitioners, we discuss key modeling choices and testable restrictions. We then consider a specification that is linear in parameters, and propose a simple Two-Stage Least Squares estimator. We revisit the empirical analysis of teenage smoking and peer effects of Lee, Li, and Lin. Our reanalysis highlights the main advantages of the linear framework, including minimal computational and data requirements and ability to handle fixed effects. Supplementary materials for this article are available online.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了二元结果中线性交互作用的一般模型。首先，我们刻画了这些模型具有连贯性和完备性的条件。接着，我们证明在信息不完全和独立性的假设下，线性交互模型能够支持合理的基础微观机制。为便于实践者应用，我们讨论了关键的建模选择及可检验的约束条件。随后，我们考虑了一种参数线性的设定，并提出了一种简单的两阶段最小二乘估计方法。我们重新审视了Lee、Li和Lin关于青少年吸烟与同伴效应的实证分析。我们的再分析凸显了线性框架的主要优势，包括极低的计算与数据需求以及处理固定效应的能力。本文的补充材料可在网上获取。
title: Binary Outcomes and Linear Interactions

abstract: This article develops a new estimator for an average partial effect in nonlinear panel models, where outcomes are time-varying monotonic transformations of latent variables that include fixed effects and endogenous regressors. The partial effect can be time-varying and the counterfactual shift is scale invariant—key advantages over the linear model. We exploit a conditional moment restriction and address the ill-posed nature of recovering the transformation functions using nonparametric instrumental variable techniques. Our estimator for the partial effect satisfies root-n asymptotic normality. We apply our method to data from the Trends in International Mathematics and Science Study, and find evidence that traditional instruction is strongly associated with improved achievement in both mathematics and science.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新的估计量，用于非线性面板模型中的平均偏效应，其中结果变量是随时间变化的潜在变量的单调变换，这些潜在变量包含固定效应和内生的解释变量。该偏效应可以随时间变化，且反事实变动具有尺度不变性——这是相对于线性模型的关键优势。我们利用条件矩约束，并采用非参数工具变量技术来解决恢复变换函数时的不适定问题。我们的偏效应估计量满足根n渐近正态性。我们将此方法应用于国际数学与科学趋势研究的数据，发现传统教学与数学和科学成绩的提升密切相关。
title: Partial Effects in Time-Varying Linear Transformation Panel Models with Endogeneity
title_zh: 时变线性变换面板模型中带内生性的偏效应

abstract: In this paper, we investigate the implementation problem that arises when the designer is uncertain about the agents’ rationality. We discuss double implementation in Nash and -Nash equilibria.We fully characterize the social choice rules which can be doubly implemented in Nash and ε-Nash equilibria.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了当设计者对参与者理性程度不确定时所产生的实施问题。我们讨论了纳什均衡与ε-纳什均衡下的双重实施。我们完整刻画了能够在纳什均衡与ε-纳什均衡下被双重实施的社会选择规则。
title: Nash and Epsilon-Nash implementation

abstract: In the early 1960s, China launched the “Construction of Third Front” (TF) industrialization campaign for national defense considerations, which significantly spurred manufacturing growth in the underdeveloped hinterland. Exploiting variation in the exposure to the TF across prefectures and cohorts, we find that the TF significantly increased human capital accumulation in the long term. These effects were plausibly driven by improved access to education and healthcare, an income effect, and the dominance of the positive effect of educational returns over the negative impact of the opportunity cost. Further analysis reveals that children with greater exposure to the TF experienced better labor market outcomes, delayed fertility, and smaller family sizes in adulthood.
abstract_zh: 20世纪60年代初，中国出于国防考虑启动了“三线建设”工业化运动，显著促进了欠发达内陆地区的制造业增长。利用不同地区和队列间对三线建设暴露程度的差异，我们发现三线建设长期显著提升了人力资本积累。这些效应可能源于教育和医疗服务可及性的改善、收入效应，以及教育回报的正向影响超过机会成本的负向影响。进一步分析显示，三线建设暴露程度较高的儿童在成年后享有更好的劳动力市场表现、生育年龄推迟及家庭规模缩小。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
source_issue: Journal of Comparative Economics, Volume 54, Issue 2
title: The long-term impact of industrialization campaigns on human capital accumulation: Evidence from the “Construction of Third Front” in China
title_zh: 工业化运动对人力资本积累的长期影响：来自中国“三线建设”的证据
